_note: Floors for scripts/ci_check.py. Retrieval floors are the measured values rounded down to 3 decimals (keyword 0.6913, hybrid 0.7826): the first Linux CI run (2026-11-13, run 43419355979) gave the same values as Windows, so no cross-platform margin is kept. Recorded-run floors are the exact baseline of each recorded run, rounded down: re-grading the same replies is deterministic, so any drop means ingestion, the citation check or the grader changed what counts as a verified answer.
